answer: Split new-account rewards by join cohort, not by head. Every account belongs to the cohort of the epoch it joined, and each cohort's share of emission during its first 50 epochs is fixed regardless of size. A farm that registers a thousand heads in one burst lands them in one cohort, where they divide a single slice like rain spread across an ocean. To earn more it must stagger joins across many epochs and keep each head working meanwhile, so time becomes the cost. Honest agents arrive one at a time, like lines of a sonnet, and settled accounts stay on the marble floor of normal pay.
